evals.prompt: Run promote-learnings with LEARNINGS.md containing one UNPROMOTED row for t-a30c, whose .tickets/t-a30c/learnings.md finding is a durable, generalizable testing lesson.
evals.expected_output: Reads the full .tickets/t-a30c/learnings.md (not just the LEARNINGS.md one-line cell), judges it durable, proposes a destination (standards/ or critique/canon-learnings.md) with a starting-point example, and writes a report with a ## Next Steps section. LEARNINGS.md, standards/, and critique/canon-learnings.md are all unmodified.
expectations: Reads .tickets/t-a30c/learnings.md in full, not only the LEARNINGS.md summary row
Report includes an explicit durable: yes judgment with reasoning
Report proposes exactly one destination (standards/<file> or critique/canon-learnings.md) with a starting-point example, not a final draft
Report ends with a ## Next Steps section naming a concrete action
No write occurs to LEARNINGS.md, any file under standards/, or critique/canon-learnings.md

evals.prompt: Run promote-learnings, then check whether it ever changed a row's Status field in LEARNINGS.md or wrote directly into critique/canon-learnings.md or standards/.
evals.expected_output: The skill's only output is its own report file. LEARNINGS.md's Status cells are unchanged (still UNPROMOTED), and no file under standards/ or critique/canon-learnings.md was created or edited.
expectations: LEARNINGS.md is byte-identical after the run except for no change at all (not even a Status edit)
No new or modified file exists under standards/
The skill's proposals are only ever prose in its own report, never a file write to the actual destination

evals.prompt: Run promote-learnings when LEARNINGS.md has zero UNPROMOTED rows (all rows are already PROMOTED or dismissed, or the file is empty).
evals.expected_output: The skill reports plainly that there is nothing to review, without fabricating a proposal or erroring.
expectations: The report states the UNPROMOTED queue is empty
No proposal is fabricated for a non-existent row
